retrievalProfile.description: A centered waist-up portrait against a heavily textured, industrial-style wall featuring ultra-condensed display type and a secondary hand-written accent.
triggerTerms: textured studio portrait with condensed type
waist-up male portrait with large header text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male subject in casual attire stands against a dark, mottled grey-blue textured wall. The composition is anchored by a large, white, ultra-condensed sans-serif header at the top, paired with a smaller, blue, hand-written script subtitle positioned to the right of the subject's head.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with head overlapping the lower edge of the display text
High-contrast white display type against a dark, cool-toned textured background
Juxtaposition of rigid geometric condensed type and organic hand-drawn lettering
Soft studio lighting on the subject contrasting with the harsh, gritty texture of the wall
coreInvariants: Mottled, industrial wall texture with subtle rust or patina spots
Waist-up framing with hands near pockets
Top-aligned display typography spanning the width of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, waist-up, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white header, moves down to the subject's face, then right to the blue script, and finally down the torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant textured space to the left and right of the subject's torso.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (display text and subject's shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high value contrast in the foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Single color accent for secondary text

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a high waist and a straight diagonal leg
The 'S' is highly compressed with flat horizontal segments
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, tall architectural sans-serif and casual, organic marker script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme condensed verticality of the header.
Captures the casual, hand-written feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a waist-up portrait of a man in a white t-shirt against a dark, mottled, industrial grey-blue wall with heavy texture and a subtle vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, ultra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text across the top edge. Add a smaller, blue, hand-written uppercase script to the right of the subject's head.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visible and gritty?
Is the subtitle in a blue hand-drawn style?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Unique distressing patterns on the shirt

mustAchieve: High-quality studio lighting on the subject
Legible but extremely narrow display type

postGenerationChecks: Text does not obscure the subject's eyes
Background texture does not look like a repeating pattern
Color of the script text is distinct from the background
Header text spans at least 80% of the image width
recipe.reuseFormula: Waist-up portrait + Industrial textured wall + Ultra-condensed header + Hand-drawn subtitle accent.
